review: Merged stable main through c0b65f1d2. Reviewed gameplay, SRV handshake, player persistence, archive hardening, audio discovery, rendering and server-side resource optimizations. Preserved Android system DNS, sandboxed .hmod execution, native queue reset, input/IME, renderer selection, smaller GPU heaps and startup recovery. Resolved new boot-renderer API and ZIP 9 integration; retained background device discovery with upstream fingerprint caching. Combined anticheat attack handling with queued-move ordering and restored required Win32 boot-paint features. Upstream deployment workflows remain inactive. Device validation of new upstream gameplay/rendering remains required; native .hnmod compilation is still unsupported. Follow-up: fetched main through 51f26d057 (1,697 additional commits). Inspected selected renderer changes including surface reconfiguration, arena compaction, sprite sampling, HDR emission and atlas limits. Kept the current c0b65f1d2 base for the installation hotfix and legacy GLES investigation; the pending batch also changes shader-pack rendering, native hooks and frame interpolation and is not yet an Android-validated release baseline. Follow-up review: fetched abbfe4996 (2,416 commits beyond the retained base). Android PRs #75 and #79 were reviewed and merged separately; this does not merge or validate the pending upstream batch.
